I have trouble justifying purchasing most digital versions of board games when Tabletop Simulator generally has free, scripted mods that're just as good (or better--looking at you, Spirit Island). …
A game too good for common people. Nearly impossible to find other players in real life.

Don't buy it if you wish to play solo against ai players. Right now it's unplayable against ai (unless you play vagabond) since the ai moves make zero sense. The ai seems oblivious of the actual scores in the game. …
世界上最好的四人桌游 是我复读最好的朋友教我玩的 可惜高考没像游戏一样胜利 没有它我真不知道怎么撑下去
非常好玩的策略桌游，初看似乎难上手，但是网上搜下说明书（国内有不少民间汉化）和配合Chatgpt很快就能明白，和朋友晚上十点开的打了三把凌晨四点了，接下来要狠狠购入实体！！ 看见那些奇怪的标，一定要拆:)
